avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer reduces cobimetinib plasma concentrations and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative herbal supplements

avoid_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor may increase cobimetinib levels and toxicity risk

caution_supplements.name: Milk thistle
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential CYP3A4 enzyme modulation may slightly affect cobimetinib metabolism
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for efficacy changes; use with caution and inform oncology team

caution_supplements.name: Turmeric/Curcumin
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have additive effects on MEK pathway; theoretical hepatic metabolism interaction
caution_supplements.action: Discuss with healthcare provider before use

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases cobimetinib bioavailability and plasma concentration
avoid_foods.action: Completely avoid grapefruit products during treatment

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase cobimetinib absorption and gastrointestinal side effects
caution_foods.action: Take cobimetinib consistently with or without food; maintain consistent dietary pattern

monitoring_notes: Monitor for increased cobimetinib toxicity (diarrhea, rash, cardiac effects) if CYP3A4 inhibitors are used concurrently. Assess treatment efficacy if potent CYP3A4 inducers are introduced, as reduced drug levels may compromise therapeutic response.
